findings.title: Missing re-check of cache after acquiring write lock (incomplete double-checked locking)
findings.body: After releasing the RLock and before acquiring the write Lock, another goroutine may have already populated `entryPointAssetsCache`. The code does not re-check the cache after acquiring the exclusive lock at line 48. In non-dev mode, this means multiple goroutines that simultaneously observe a nil cache will all serialize on the write lock and each redundantly perform the expensive file I/O (reading and parsing assets-manifest.json). The standard double-checked locking pattern requires re-checking the condition after upgrading to the write lock: after line 49, add `if cfg.Env != setting.Dev && entryPointAssetsCache != nil { return entryPointAssetsCache, nil }` to avoid redundant work during startup bursts.
